Frequency once per encounter

Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points, or every firearm you wield is emptied at once.

There is one more. Immediately make a ranged Strike with each firearm you wield at a +2 circumstance bonus and treating the targets as off-guard, before the triggering effect resolves. If the trigger was being reduced to 0 Hit Points, you then fall as normal, and everyone watching will describe the order of events incorrectly for years.
